stage: Geography inputs only; no patients or policy outcomes
selection_rule: Exact PSA/OSM name match, inside OSM city boundary, nearest station within 5 km; Linao near/lower-middle/far and Tanza near/far in ordered eligible lists. Ties by PSGC. 5 km footprint and 3/2 quota are demonstration design assumptions.
assignment_rule: Minimum unrounded haversine distance; tie by station_id. Select BEFORE time floor; keep assignment fixed across policies and travel multipliers. This is not an official catchment.
floor_order: Apply baseline floor first; multiply resulting time. Slow/fast scenarios may have minimum 10/2.5 minutes.
round_trip: 2 * one_way_minutes; same outbound/return assumed; add service duration separately later
limitations: Settlement reference points do not represent all homes or within-barangay travel
Straight-line travel estimate is not routed or measured time; rivers/road detours may be omitted
No clinical timing or outcome claims; no catchment/staff confirmation
PSA geography table July 2025, population 2024; exact OSM cutoff unverified
5 km footprint and selected near/far coverage are not representative city sampling
